description: Hi! I'm Julian, and we're a team of 5 people who want to learn, have fun, and make new friends. If you enjoy teamwork and sharing ideas, you're welcome here! You don't need much experience, just a good attitude and a willingness to learn. We're almost full, but we still have room for a few more members!
summary: Aether: Zero Orbit is an educational space simulation that makes advanced space science and aerospace engineering easier to learn and more fun. Aether blends physics, spacecraft design orbital mechanics and resource management into a learning adventure. Aether lets you explore space missions make engineering choices manage spacecraft systems and see the science behind space travel. By turning ideas into interactive challenges Aether pushes you to learn by doing instead of by memorizing facts. Aether takes inspiration from NASAs style of space exploration. Hopes to ignite curiosity grow scientific thinking and show how physics and engineering work beyond Earth. Aether’s value lies in making aerospace knowledge easier to grasp and, in inspiring the wave of space explorers, scientists and engineers
details:
Our project consists of a rocket-building ecosystem that allows users to travel to celestial bodies. It provides an entertaining and interactive way to learn the fundamental concepts of rocketry and how to assemble rockets.

Our main goal is to replace complex books, tutorials, and articles with a more intuitive system, making science accessible to people with little or no prior scientific knowledge. We want everyone to understand the different aspects of space exploration through an engaging learning experience.

We used several artificial intelligence tools, including Gemini, DeepSeek, Claude, ChatGPT, and others, to help develop our project.

Our project is creative because most participants tend to focus on creating the "perfect project that will save humanity," sometimes forgetting that the simplest ideas can be the most useful. Instead, we aim to use a video game to introduce beginners to the fascinating world of space exploration.

Throughout development, we considered real-world physics and engineering principles. Our game is not just another simulator with no connection to reality. It is an interactive ecosystem where players must use the tools and resources available to overcome physical challenges, work with the laws of the universe, and successfully reach their destinations.
